# controld_profiles (Data Source)

Lists all ControlD profiles in the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "controld_profiles" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `profiles` (Attributes List) The list of profiles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The profile identifier (PK).
- `name` (String) The name of the profile.
- `updated` (Number) The Unix timestamp of the last update to the profile.
